reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The provision of financing for rehabilitation of the existing transformer of 3*167MVA at 500/220/35 kV substation in the Sugd region of Tajikistan (the "Project") in the form of up to EUR 10.2 million sovereign loan to the Republic of Tajikistan with loan proceeds to be on-lent to OJSC Shabaqahoi Intiqoli Barq, the implementing entity. The loan will be co-financed by investment grants from the EBRD Shareholder Special Fund (the "SSF") in the amount of up to EUR 3.5 million and the Sustainable Infrastructure Fund ("SIF"), administered by the Bank, in the amount of up to EUR 1 million. The implementation of the Project shall contribute to strengthening of the power sector in Tajikistan by reducing losses, improving collection rates and revenue streams. The Project objectives are to address the most urgent needs for the replacement of aged infrastructure and to contribute towards the reduction of transmission network losses resulting in financial and CO2 emissions savings. The Project shall strengthen reliability and stability of the transmission network and improve capacity of the electricity system.
